title: Deep learning scores rheumatoid arthritis activity from multimodal ultrasound
summary: RATING reached 86.1% accuracy on a prospective test dataset and 85.0% on an external test set. In a reader study, it raised the average accuracy of 10 radiologists from 41.4% to 64.0%. Cohort sizes are not given in the abstract; it is a diagnostic assistance tool.
ai_technology: RATING, a knowledge-guided deep learning system with self-supervised pretraining on multimodal ultrasound

evidence.tested: Prospective and external test sets; reader study
evidence.unknown: Cohort sizes not seen in abstract; diagnostic assist tool; full text not reviewed.
